levels.description: ATK <@ba.vup>+{atk:0%}</>, attacks 2 enemies simultaneously, and attacking targets that are not <$ba.sleep>Asleep</> puts them to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> for <@ba.vup>{attack@sleep}</>s; all enemies awakening from <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> or defeated during <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> receive Arts damage (damage based on <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> duration, up to <@ba.vup>{max_atk_scale:0%}</> ATK), and put one other nearby enemy to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> for <@ba.vup>{sleep}</>s; when other allied Operators within Attack Range receive lethal damage, they are instead put to <$ba.sleep>Sleep</> until fully healed or skill ends
